verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser is an immigration firm with a startups practice and an O-1 page, so a documented O-1 to green-card path is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence mentions EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, or any green-card strategy following the O-1. The startup book, the O-3 dependent coverage, and Visalaw AI prompts about I-485/I-130 policy changes are adjacent topics, not a documented continuation strategy.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents the green-card continuation — EB-1A or EB-2 NIW strategy after the work visa — so the O-1 is a path, not a dead end
